{{further|2026 Wuhan Open}}

[[Maja Chwalińska]] defeated [[Sonay Kartal]] in the final, 2–6, 6–4, 6–2 to win the singles tennis title at the [[2026 Wuhan Open]]. It was her first career [[WTA Tour]] title. Chwalińska was the fourth player (after [[Naomi Osaka]], [[Bianca Andreescu]], and [[Victoria Mboko]]) to win a [[WTA 1000]] event as their first tour-level singles title.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wtatennis.com/news/4593967/chwalinska-rallies-past-kartal-for-first-wta-title-in-wuhan|title=Chwalinska’s breakout season reaches new heights with a WTA 1000 title in Wuhan|publisher=Women's Tennis Association|accessdate=18 October 2026}}</ref>

[[Coco Gauff]] was the reigning champion,<ref>{{Cite web|title = 'I appreciate you': Gauff defeats friend, former doubles partner Pegula for Wuhan title|publisher=Women's Tennis Association|date= 12 October 2025|url=https://www.wtatennis.com/news/4380604/i-appreciate-you-gauff-defeats-friend-former-doubles-partner-pegula-for-wuhan-title|accessdate= 13 October 2025}}</ref> but withdrew before the tournament due to fatigue.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wtatennis.com/news/4588144/coco-gauff-naomi-osaka-to-miss-wuhan-open|title=Coco Gauff, Naomi Osaka to miss Wuhan Open|publisher=Women's Tennis Association|accessdate=7 October 2026}}</ref>

Ranked as the world No. 170, Kartal was the lowest-ranked WTA 1000 finalist since the format was introduced in 2009.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/tennis/sonay-kartal-jelena-ostapenko-wuhan-open-result-b3068510.html|title=Sonay Kartal makes history by reaching biggest final of her career in Wuhan|publisher=The Independent|date=17 October 2026|accessdate=17 October 2026}}</ref> The semifinal match between [[Iga Świątek]] and Chwalińska marked the first all-Polish semifinal in WTA Tour history.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wtatennis.com/news/4593246/wuhan-semifinal-preview-iga-swiatek-maja-chwalinska-jelena-ostapenko-sonay-kartal|title=Wuhan semifinals preview: An all-Polish reunion and a pair of surprises|publisher=Women's Tennis Association|accessdate=16 October 2026}}</ref>
